angleRead.text: The record is 8-1, and the streak is four. That is the structure I am supposed to read, and I keep circling it the way I circle the grate on College Avenue — looking for the thing that was left behind on purpose. The Oaks have not lost since the season turned, and the shape of the infield has changed underneath them. Quintero moves across the diamond, Clark and Hernandez split the hot corner, and the team keeps winning. That is the load-bearing fact: the wall did not move, only the hands on it. plan.why: The assignment asks for a structural interpretation of a sustained record, not a game recap and not a history lesson. That is the civic architecture — the thing that holds when the people inside it shift.
